pages.raw_title: Herc Rentals – Equipment & Tool Rental Solutions
pages.raw_meta: Find reliable equipment and tool rentals at Herc Rentals. Choose daily, weekly, or monthly rates across 610+ locations.
raw_blocks: Browse our Equipment and Tools
From power and cooling to site prep and security, Herc Rentals delivers fast, reliable equipment solutions tailored for data centers and digital infrastructure projects.
From day-to-day maintenance and planned project support to the technical assistance needed in response to unplanned or emergency events.
Herc Rentals works behind the scenes by providing our partners in the utility industry with the solutions and gear they need in both day-to-day operations and emergencies.
As temperatures rise, renting an air conditioner can be a great solution to keep your project site cool and comfortable.
Does Herc Rentals service my area? Yes, Herc Rentals has 600+ locations across North America. Find the Nearest Branch .
Can I get the equipment delivered to my job site? Yes, Herc Rentals can deliver and pickup equipment to/from your job site.
Herc Rentals offers live delivery tracking and service calls to ensure timely delivery. You can set up alerts and notifications to stay updated on delivery and pick-up progress.
Can I make a reservation? You can make a reservation through HercRentals.com or by contacting the customer solutions team at 1(833)-311-0247.
Are weekly or monthly rates available? Herc Rentals offers daily, weekly, and monthly rates for equipment rentals.

How do I check if the equipment I need is available for rent? You can check the availability of the equipment you need by visiting HercRentals.com or by contacting the customer solutions team at 1(833)-311-0247.
Do I need a CDL to operate equipment? You do not need a CDL to operate most of the equipment rented from Herc Rentals. However, specific equipment may have different requirements.
Does Herc Rentals provide safety training? Yes, Herc Rentals offers safety training .

What happens if a tool or equipment breaks down while I'm using it? If a tool or equipment breaks down while you're using it, you can contact Herc Rentals for service calls. We offer 24/7 emergency service.

Is there customer support available if I have questions or issues arise? Yes, Herc Rentals provides customer support for any questions or issues that arise. You can contact the customer solutions team at 1(833)-311-0247.
Can I call someone after hours? Herc Rentals offers 24/7 emergency service, so you can call someone after hours, if needed.
Is H&E Rentals now part of the Herc Rentals team? Yes, and you can learn more here .

Herc Rentals strives to have the best and broadest selection of premium rental equipment available and ready when our customers need it, ensuring it performs as promised, and providing unsurpassed customer service at every opportunity. Our fleet encompasses equipment for rent from the following categories: Aerial, Air Compressors & Tools, Climate Control equipment, Compaction & Paving, Concrete & Masonry, Earthmoving, Floor Care & Surface Prep, Material Handling, Power Generation, ProContractor tools equipment, Pump, Remediation & Restoration, Construction equipment, Heavy equipment and Trucks & Trailers.
